title: Checking the renewal status
passage:
I take it the landlord hasn’t signed the renewal yet?
A. That was true when I checked this morning.
B. We did take a copy of the old lease.
C. The new rent is printed in the first paragraph.
passageZh:
我猜房東還沒簽續約，對吧？
A. 我早上查的時候是這樣。
B. 我們確實拿了一份舊租約。
C. 新租金印在第一段。
